newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Tupras's capital increase to go ahead.
newsitem.headline: Turk Tupras's capital increase to go ahead.

text.p: Turkey's privatisation administration (OIB) approved a capital increase in the state petroleum refiner Tupras-Turkiye Petrol Rafinerileri A.S., the Istanbul Stock Exchange reported.
The OIB holds a 96.41 percent stake in Tupras which is slated for privatisation.
Tupras's capital will be raised to 29.901 trillion lira from 4.672 trillion lira by issuing 2.7 bonuses and 2.7 rights for one existing share.

Almost all listed firms exercise rights issues at 1,000 lira nominal value per share. Permission from the regulatory Capital Markets Board (SPK) must also be secured before the capital increase can take place.
